name: Lazare Osiashvili
description: FEI Level 1 Steward & Equestrian Operations Specialist. Supporting the Georgian Equestrian Federation since 2022 across national and World Cup Qualifier events alongside elite FEI Course Designers and Chief Stewards. An active Jump Crew member and rider with broad operational expertise in show jumping course layout, arena aesthetics, and international tournament setup. Highly detail-oriented, hard-working, and passionate about maintaining the highest standards in equine sport.
